Trigger ErrorLogEventSubscriber

trigger ErrorLogEventSubscriber on ErrorLogEvent__e (after insert)

Platform Event subscriber that listens to ErrorLogEvent__e events and persists them as ErrorLog__c records.

This trigger provides asynchronous error logging functionality by subscribing to error log platform events published via ErrorUtils.publish(). Each platform event is converted into an ErrorLog__c record and inserted into the database using partial success mode to ensure that a single malformed event does not cause the entire batch to fail.

Usage:

  • Automatically triggered when error log platform events are published
  • Supports asynchronous, fire-and-forget error logging
  • Enables real-time error monitoring and alerting through platform events
  • Allows error logging to succeed even when the publishing transaction rolls back
